verses.en: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.sm: Isaraelu e, ina faalogologo mai ia. Le aiga o le tupu e, ina liliu mai ia O outou fofoga, aua ua faasalaina outou, ua avea outou ma matásele i Mesepa, ma upega ua folasia i Tapora.

verses.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.sm: Ua faateleina le fasi e i latou ua liliu ese, a o aʻu, ou te aoai atu ia te i latou uma.

verses.en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
verses.sm: O aʻu ua ou iloa Efaraima, o Isaraelu foi ua le lilo lava ia ia te au; aua, Efaraima e, ua e faitaaga nei, ua leaga Isaraelu.

verses.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
verses.sm: Latou te le sauniuni a latou galuega ina ia latou liliu mai i lo latou Atua; aua o i totonu ia te i latou le fia faitaaga, latou te le iloa le ALII.

verses.en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
verses.sm: Ua molimau le faamaualuga o Isaraelu i o latou luma, e pauu Isaraelu ma Efaraima i a latou agasala; e paù foi Iuta faatasi ma i latou.

verses.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.sm: Latou te o atu ma a latou mamoe ma a latou povi e sailiili atu ai i le ALII; a e latou te le maua; ua auo ese o ia ia te i latou.

verses.en: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.sm: Ua pepelo i latou i le ALII; auā ua fanau e i latou a latou tama ese; o le a ‘aina nei i latou, atoa ma o latou tofi i le masina e tasi.

verses.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.sm: Ia outou ilia le sofao i Kipea, ma le pu i Rama; ia outou alalaga i Petavene; Peniamina e, o loo mulimuli atu o ia ia te ce.

verses.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.sm: E faatafunaina Efaraima i ona po o le aoaiga; ua ou faailoaina atu i itu aiga o Isaraelu, o le upu moni lava.

verses.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.sm: O alii o luta sa faapei o tagata e sii le tuaoi i latou; ou te liligi atu Ic'u ita faapei o le vai ia te i latou.

verses.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.sm: Ua faasauaina Efaraima, ua lomia i le faamasinoga; aua ua usiusitai o ia ma lona loto i le poloaiga.

verses.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.sm: O a‘u foi e pei o se mogamoga i Efaraima; e pei o se mea e pala foi i le aiga o Iuta.

verses.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.sm: Na iloa e Efaraima lona maʻi, na iloa foi e Iuta lona manua, ona alu lea o Efaraima i Asuria, na alu lana feau ia larepa le tupu; a ua le mafai lava ia te ia ona faamalolo ia te outou, pe faamafuina o outou manua.

verses.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.sm: Auā e avea aʻu e pei o se leona ia Efaraima, E pei o se leona taanoa foi i le aiga o Iuta; o a‘u lava ou te saeia ma alu ese, ou te aveesea, e leai foi se na te laveaiina.

verses.en: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.sm: Ou te alu, ou te toe foi lava i le mea ou te nofo ai, seia faasalaina lava i latou, ma latou saili ia te au; latou te vave saili ia te au pe a puapuagatia i latou.
